dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: アナライザが稼働しました。CRダンジョンを抜けるまでの間、破壊可能地点が明示されます。
dialogues.original_en: The Analyzer has begun operating. Until you leave the dungeon, all destructable points will be marked.
dialogues.current_ptbr: O Analisador foi ativado. Todos os pontos destrutíveis serão marcados até você sair da masmorra.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エンカウント
dialogues.original_en: Encounters
dialogues.current_ptbr: Encontros

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 敵の出現するフィールドでは、画面右下にエンカウントゲージが表示されます。
dialogues.original_en: On fields where enemies can appear, an Encounter gauge will be displayed in the lower right of the screen.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Em áreas com inimigos, o medidor de encontros aparece no canto inferior direito.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 移動するとゲージの色が変わっていき、赤に近づくほど敵の出現率が高くなります。ですがゲージの色が青に近い状態でも、敵は出現します。油断しないように!
dialogues.original_en: The color changes when you move; the redder it becomes, the higher the chance of meeting an enemy. But there is still a chance to encounter an enemy even when the gauge is close to blue. Don’t let your guard down!
dialogues.current_ptbr: A cor muda ao caminhar. Quanto mais vermelha, maior a chance de encontro. Mesmo perto do azul, ainda pode haver inimigos. Não baixe a guarda!

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 敵を倒すか逃げるかして戦闘が終了すると、エンカウントゲージは減少します。ゲージがゼロになると、以後、そのフィールドを移動し回っても敵は出現しなくなります。
dialogues.original_en: When the battle ends after defeating the enemy or fleeing, the encounter gauge will decrease. When the gauge is 0, enemies will no longer appear no matter how much you move around on the map.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Após vencer ou fugir, o medidor diminui. Quando chega a zero, não surgem mais inimigos, mesmo que você continue andando.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エンカウントゲージは各CRフィールドごとに設定されています。他のフィールドに移動したり、一度ワールドマップに出るなどした場合、エンカウントゲージは回復します。うまく利用して、レベル上げなどに使ってください。
dialogues.original_en: The encounter gauge is set to each field. If you move to another field, or go out to the world map, the encounter gauge will recover. You can use this wisely for leveling.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cada área tem seu medidor. Mudar de área ou sair ao mapa-múndi o restaura. Use isso para subir de nível.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: パワード
dialogues.original_en: Enhancing
dialogues.current_ptbr: Aprimoramento

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 戦闘やお店で手に入るグラスノ結晶を使い、ライナー達の装備を強化することができます。メニューの装備から現在の装備を選び、さらにパワードを選択してください。
dialogues.original_en: You can strengthen your equipment by using Grathnode Crystals obtained from battle or shops. Select from your current equipment on the equipment list, and then select Enhance.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Fortaleça equipamentos com Cristais Grathnode de lojas ou batalhas. Selecione uma peça equipada e escolha Aprimorar.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 装備品には最大4つのグラスノ結晶をつけられます。つけたグラスノ結晶の効果はそのまま反映されますが、中には効果の重ならないグラスノ結晶もあります。
dialogues.original_en: You can equip up to 4 Grathnode Crystals on equipment. The effects of the Grathnode Crystals will be directly applied, but some Grathnode Crystals’ effects will not overlap.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cada equipamento aceita até quatro cristais. Seus efeitos são aplicados diretamente, mas alguns efeitos iguais não se acumulam.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: またレベルの高いグラスノ結晶は、つけられる場所に限りがあります。グラスノ結晶の持つレベルより高いレベルにはつけられません。
dialogues.original_en: Also, there are limits to where you can place high level Grathnode Crystals. You cannot place crystals in equipment slots that are lower level than the level of the crystal.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cristais de nível alto exigem espaços de nível compatível. Não é possível instalar um cristal num espaço de nível inferior ao dele.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: パワードにより、ライナー達の攻撃力は格段にアップします。いろいろな結晶を組み合わせて、自分だけのパワードを作り出してください。
dialogues.original_en: Depending on the enhancement, the attack power of Lyner and his party can dramatically increase. Combine crystals and create your unique enhancements.
dialogues.current_ptbr: As melhorias podem aumentar muito o ataque do grupo. Combine cristais para criar aprimoramentos próprios.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: グラスメルク
dialogues.original_en: Grathmeld
dialogues.current_ptbr: Grathmeld

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: グラスメルクは宿屋とキャンプのメニューから選択できます。
dialogues.original_en: Grathmeld can be selected from the menu from the Inn or Camp.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Grathmeld pode ser escolhido no menu da pousada ou do acampamento.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 作るアイテムを選択すると、調合の材料が表示されます。材料となるアイテムの品質で、作るアイテムの品質が決まります。グラスノ結晶が材料となるアイテムもあります。
dialogues.original_en: When you select the item you want to create, the ingredients for synthesis will be displayed. The quality of the ingredient will decide the quality of the item you are making. There are items which use Grathnode Crystals as ingredients too.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Selecione o item para ver os ingredientes. A qualidade deles determina a do resultado. Algumas receitas também usam Cristais Grathnode.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: その次は、アイテムをいくつ作るか決めてください。全てを決定すると、調合が始まります。
dialogues.original_en: Next, select how many of the item you wish to create. Once everything is confirmed, the synthesis will begin.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Escolha a quantidade que deseja criar. Após confirmar tudo, a síntese começa.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 完成です。作ったアイテムは、メインメニューのアイテム欄に追加されています。
dialogues.original_en: It is now complete. The item you have created will be added to the item list in the main menu.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Pronto! O item criado será adicionado à lista de itens do menu principal.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 品質の異なるアイテムを作った場合、どの品質を残すかを決定する必要があります。
dialogues.original_en: When you create items of different quality, you must choose which quality you would like to keep.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ao criar itens de qualidades diferentes, escolha qual qualidade deseja manter.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 混ぜるを選ぶと、元から持っていた数に作ったアイテムの数がプラスされます。ただし、品質は平均化されるため、品質の高いアイテムを残したい時は注意してください。
dialogues.original_en: If you decide to combine, the number of items will be added to however many you originally had. But the quality will be averaged, so be careful if you want to keep a higher quality item.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Combinar soma as quantidades, mas calcula a média da qualidade. Cuidado se quiser preservar um item de qualidade alta.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 材料が足りない場合、グラスメルクはできません。グラスメルクを使えば、お店で売っている物より強力なアイテムを創ることもできます。使いこなせば冒険がぐっと楽に!
dialogues.original_en: If you do not have enough ingredients, you will not be able to Grathmeld. If you use Grathmeld, you will be able to create items that are stronger than those you can buy in stores. Make use of this to help your adventure.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Sem ingredientes suficientes, não há Grathmeld. Ele permite criar itens melhores que os das lojas. Use-o para ajudar na aventura.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レシピカード
dialogues.original_en: Recipe Card
dialogues.current_ptbr: Carta de receita

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: グラスメルクでアイテムを作るには、そのアイテムのレシピを知る必要があります。レシピは、アイテムのレシピCRカードを手に入れることで覚えることができます。
dialogues.original_en: In order to make an item with Grathmeld, you must know the item’s recipe. You can learn the recipe by obtaining the recipe card for that item.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Para criar um item com Grathmeld, aprenda sua receita obtendo a respectiva carta.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レシピカードはお店や塔の宝箱、イベントなどで手に入れることができます。所有したことのないアイテムでもレシピさえ知っていればアイテム欄に登録されます。
dialogues.original_en: You can find recipe cards in shops, treasure chests in the tower, and from events. Even if you have never had the item, as long as you know the recipe, it will be registered in the item list.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cartas de receita vêm de lojas, baús da Torre e eventos. Conhecer a receita registra o item na lista, mesmo sem nunca tê-lo possuído.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レシピの中には、お店では絶対手に入らない貴重なアイテムの作り方もあります。ぜひ色々なレシピを探してみてください。ゲームを進める上で大きな力になるかも...?
dialogues.original_en: There are some recipes that will teach you how to make rare items that are not obtainable in shops. Look for all kinds of different recipes. It can important in progressing through the game.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Algumas receitas criam itens raros que não são vendidos. Procure receitas variadas: podem ser importantes para avançar.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: アンビエンスフィールド
dialogues.original_en: Ambience Field
dialogues.current_ptbr: Campo ambiente

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 戦闘中、敵の上に表示されるポインターを、アンビエンスフィールドと呼びます。アンビエンスフィールドは、詩魔法を強化する共振装置のような役割を果たします。
dialogues.original_en: The Ambience Field is the pointer above the enemy in the battlefield. The Ambience Field works as a resonating device to amplify Song Magic.
dialogues.current_ptbr: O Campo Ambiente é o indicador acima do inimigo em batalha. Ressoa para amplificar a Magia da Canção.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: アンビエンスフィールドは攻撃やスキルによってダメージを与えることでレベルアップします。
dialogues.original_en: The Ambience Field will level up by applying damage with attacks and skills.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Danos de ataques e habilidades elevam o nível do Campo Ambiente.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 攻撃が連続でヒットすると、レベルは最大3まで上昇しますが、時間がたつごとにレベルはまた下がっていきます。詩魔法を発動させるにはレベルが高い時を狙いましょう。
dialogues.original_en: If attacks lands continously, the level inceases (max lvl3), but as time goes by, the level will slowly come back down. Try to activate a Song Magic when the level is high.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ataques seguidos elevam o nível até 3, mas ele cai com o tempo. Ative a Magia da Canção quando estiver alto.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 詩魔法の威力は、アンビエンスフィールドのレベルで大きく上がります。バーストゲージとうまく合わせれば、一撃必殺も狙えます!
dialogues.original_en: The effectiveness of the Song Magic will greatly increase with the Ambience Field. If you match it with the Burst Gauge, you can even get a one shot kill!
dialogues.current_ptbr: O Campo Ambiente fortalece muito a Magia da Canção. Combinado ao medidor Burst, pode permitir uma vitória com um só golpe!

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ハーモニクス
dialogues.original_en: Harmonics
dialogues.current_ptbr: Harmonics

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルが戦闘に加わると、画面下にゲージが表示されるようになります。これがハーモニクスです。
dialogues.original_en: When a Reyvateil joins the battle, a gauge is displayed at the bottom of the screen. This is Harmonics.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Quando uma Reyvateil entra em batalha, surge um medidor abaixo da tela: Harmonics.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ハーモニクスゲージは、戦闘中にそれぞれの感情が高まることにより上昇します。ゲージの青はパーティキャラの感情、ゲージの赤はレーヴァテイルの感情を示しています。
dialogues.original_en: The Harmonics gauge will increase during battle as the characters become excited. The blue on th gauge is the party’s emotions, the red is the Reyvateils’ emotions.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Harmonics cresce com o entusiasmo dos personagens. Azul representa as emoções do grupo; vermelho, as da Reyvateil.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: こちらが敵を攻撃すると、青いゲージが上がります。反対に敵の攻撃を受けると、青のゲージは下がります。また、レーヴァテイルのゲージは時間経過で上がっていきます。
dialogues.original_en: When you attack the enemy, the blue gauge will increase. On the other hand, when you receive an attack from the enemy, the blue gauge will decrease. The Reyvateil’s gauge will increase as time goes by.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Atacar aumenta a barra azul; sofrer ataques a reduz. A barra da Reyvateil cresce com o tempo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: またレーヴァテイルが敵から攻撃を受けると赤いゲージが下がります。レーヴァテイルが気絶すると、ハーモニクスは消滅してしまいます。注意してください。
dialogues.original_en: When the Reyvateil is attacked by the enemy, the red gauge will decrease. If the Reyvateil faints, the Harmonics will disappear. Be aware.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Se a Reyvateil for atacada, a barra vermelha cai. Se ela desmaiar, Harmonics desaparece. Cuidado.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ハーモニクスが上昇し、レベルアップすると、画面左下のランプが点灯します。レベルアップによりライナー達の攻撃力が上がり、また攻撃がCRバージョンアップします。
dialogues.original_en: When Harmonics rises and levels up, a lamp in the lower left will light up. The level-up will increase Lyner’s attack power, along with upgrades to the attacks.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ao subir de nível, Harmonics acende uma luz no canto inferior esquerdo. Isso aumenta o ataque de Lyner e melhora seus golpes.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 通常ハーモニクスはレベル1までです。赤魔法を発動させ、リミットゲージのレベルを上げることにより初めて、レベル2、レベル3まで上げることが可能となります。
dialogues.original_en: Normally, Harmonics is limited to level 1. By activating red magic and raising the gauge level limit, you will be able to raise it to level 2 and 3.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Normalmente Harmonics só chega ao nível 1. Ative magia vermelha para elevar o limite e alcançar os níveis 2 e 3.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ハーモニクスを使いこなせば、戦闘での大きな武器になります!
dialogues.original_en: If you can make use of Harmonics, it can become a powerful help in battle!
dialogues.current_ptbr: Domine Harmonics para obter grande ajuda em batalha!

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 戦闘中の詩魔法
dialogues.original_en: Song Magic during Battle
dialogues.current_ptbr: Magia da Canção em batalha

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 戦闘中、IM03ボタンを押すことにより、レーヴァテイルのコマンドが選択できます。武器を持たないレーヴァテイルにとって、攻撃手段は詩魔法のみです。
dialogues.original_en: During battle, by pushing the IM03 button, you can select a command for the Reyvateil. Reyvateil do not carry weapons, so they can only attack by Song Magic.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Pressione IM03 para escolher um comando da Reyvateil. Ela não usa armas: só ataca com Magia da Canção.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 赤魔法を選択した場合、発動までレーヴァテイルはMPを消費し、バーストゲージを上昇させます。レーヴァテイルのスピード値やコスチュームなどで上昇率は変わります。
dialogues.original_en: When using red magic, the Reyvateil will use MP until activation to raise the burst gauge. The speed and costume of the Reyvateil will affect the rate of increase.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ao cantar magia vermelha, a Reyvateil gasta MP para elevar Burst até a ativação. Sua velocidade e seu traje afetam o crescimento.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ゲージが一定以上にたまると、詩魔法が次のレベルに上がります。威力・効果が変わるほか、レーヴァテイルとの関係が深まると、さらにレベルに応じたカスタマイズができるようになります。
dialogues.original_en: When the gauge is filled to a certain amount, the Song Magic will go up to the next level. The power and effect will change, and in addition, depending on your relation to the Reyvateil, you will be able to customize to the level.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ao atingir certa carga, a Canção sobe de nível, mudando força e efeito. Sua relação com a Reyvateil também permite personalizar o nível.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 再びIM03ボタンでレーヴァテイルのコマンドを呼び出してください。詩魔法の選択コマンドが、「発動」コマンドに変わっているはずです。敵を選択して「発動」!
dialogues.original_en: Press the IM03 button again to bring up the Reyvateil command. The command to select Song Magic will change to ”Activate”. Select the enemy and ”Activate”!
dialogues.current_ptbr: Pressione IM03 de novo. O comando de Magia da Canção vira 'Ativar'. Escolha o inimigo e ative!

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 詩魔法はレーヴァテイルから放たれ、敵へと襲いかかります。バーストゲージの数値が高いほど、詩魔法の威力も高くなります。ゲージをため、必殺の一撃を狙いましょう!
dialogues.original_en: The Song Magic will release and attack the enemy. The higher the burst gauge value, the stronger the Song Magic. Try to get a strong attack by storing up the gauge.
dialogues.current_ptbr: A Canção é liberada contra o inimigo. Quanto maior Burst, mais forte o ataque. Acumule carga para causar muito dano.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 青魔法
dialogues.original_en: Blue Magic
dialogues.current_ptbr: Magia Azul

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルの詩は、攻撃専用ではありません。CRパーティの体力を回復させたり、ステータスを上げるための詩が青魔法です。
dialogues.original_en: Reyvateils’ songs are not only for attacking. There are songs that can recover the party’s health and increase stats called blue magic.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Canções não servem só para atacar. A magia azul cura o grupo e aumenta atributos.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 赤魔法と違い、青魔法は謳い出した瞬間から発動します。青魔法により呼び出されたCRキャラクターがパーティメンバーを回復してくれます。
dialogues.original_en: Unlike red magic, blue magic will activate the moment you start singing. The character that is summoned by the blue magic will recover the party members.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ao contrário da vermelha, a magia azul age assim que o canto começa. O personagem invocado cura os aliados.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 続けるほどに、青魔法の力は高まっていきます。また発動中にキャンセルしたい場合は「詩魔法の中断」を選んでください。敵の能力に合わせて詩魔法を使い分けましょう!
dialogues.original_en: The longer it continues, the stronger the power of the blue magic becomes. If you want to stop the magic, select ”Stop Song.” Use different Song Magics depending on the enemy’s abilities.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Quanto mais tempo cantar, mais forte a magia azul fica. Para encerrar, escolha 'Parar Canção'. Adapte as magias ao inimigo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: インストール
dialogues.original_en: Install
dialogues.current_ptbr: Instalar

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: インストールとは、グラスノ結晶を使い、詩にグラスノ結晶の持つ効果を追加する詩魔法の強化です。インストールは宿屋かキャンプのメニューから実行できます。
dialogues.original_en: Installs are upgrades to Song Magic where, by using a Grathnode Crystal, you can add the crystal’s effect to the song. You can Install at the inn or menu in camp.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Instalar Cristais Grathnode adiciona seus efeitos às Canções. Faça isso no menu da pousada ou do acampamento.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 詩魔法1つにつき、最大4つのグラスノ結晶がスロットのレベルに応じてインストールできます。同じ効果のグラスノ結晶は何個つけても一個分の効果となるので、注意を。
dialogues.original_en: For each Song Magic, a maximum of 4 Grathnode Crystals may be installed according to the level of the slot. Putting more than one Grathnode Crystal of the same effect will only count for one effect.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cada Canção aceita até quatro cristais, conforme o nível dos espaços. Cristais com o mesmo efeito só contam uma vez.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: またグラスノ結晶が効果を発揮するには、詩魔法のレベルを上げる必要があります。レベル4のグラスノ結晶は、詩魔法のレベルが4の時でないと効果がありません。詩魔法のためやすさも考えて、インストールの組み合わせを考えましょう。
dialogues.original_en: In order to maximize the effect of the Grathnode Crystal, you must raise the level of the Song Magic. A level 4 Grathnode Crystal will only be effective when the Song Magic is at least level 4. Think of the best combination for the Song Magic when doing an Install.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Para aproveitar um cristal, eleve a Canção ao nível exigido. Um cristal de nível 4 só funciona numa Canção de nível 4 ou mais. Planeje a combinação.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: グラスノ結晶をインストールした分、詩魔法の消費MPも高くなります。強化する時は、MPの消費量に注意してください。
dialogues.original_en: By installing Grathnode Crystals, the Song Magic will use more MP. Watch out for MP consumption when upgrading the song.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cristais instalados aumentam o consumo de MP. Fique atento ao aprimorar Canções.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: トランキリティ
dialogues.original_en: Tranquility
dialogues.current_ptbr: Tranquilidade

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 通常、レーヴァテイルのMPは自動的に回復しますが、詩魔法を謳っている間はMPが減り続けます。詩魔法の発動前にMP切れが起きると、詩魔法は暴発してしまいます。
dialogues.original_en: Normally, Reyvateils’ MP regenerates automatically, but while she sings a Song Magic, MP will continue to decrease. If MP runs out before the Song Magic is activated, the Song Magic will explode.
dialogues.current_ptbr: O MP se regenera normalmente, mas cai durante o canto. Se acabar antes da ativação, a Magia da Canção explode.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: トランキリティは戦闘中に使える、MPの回復用アイテムです。
dialogues.original_en: Tranquility is an item used for recovering MP during battle.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Tranquilidade recupera MP em batalha.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: MPが少なくなるとレーヴァテイルがフラフラします。CR詩魔法を消したくないとき、さらに威力を上げたいときは、トランキリティを使い、回復してあげましょう。
dialogues.original_en: When a Reyvateil is low on MP, she will become dizzy. If you do not want to stop the Song Magic, or want to increase the power even more, use Tranquility to heal them.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Com pouco MP, a Reyvateil fica tonta. Use Tranquilidade se quiser continuar cantando ou aumentar ainda mais a força.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: トランキリティはグラスメルクで作ることができます。CRレーヴァテイルのために常備しておくといいでしょう。材料は唄石とグラスノ結晶です。
dialogues.original_en: You can make Tranquility by Grathmelding. You should always have these for the Reyvateil. The ingredients are Song Stones and Grathnode Crystals.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Crie Tranquilidade por Grathmelding com Pedras de Canção e Cristais Grathnode. Tenha sempre algumas para a Reyvateil.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ダイブ
dialogues.original_en: Dive
dialogues.current_ptbr: Merg.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 戦闘によって得たDPは、ダイブで使うことが出来ます。プレイヤーはレーヴァテイルの精神世界へダイブすることにより、その真の力を引き出していきます。
dialogues.original_en: DP that you gain from battle is used for Diving. You can Dive into the soulspace of the Reyvateil and bring out her true powers.
dialogues.current_ptbr: DP obtido em batalha serve para Mergulhos. Entre no Espaço da Alma da Reyvateil para despertar seu verdadeiro poder.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルは精神世界に「心の護」とも呼ばれる存在を持っています。彼女達は、レーヴァテイルの心を護り、またその成長を見守っていく存在です。
dialogues.original_en: Reyvateils have an entity called a ”Mind Guardian” in their soulspace. They protect the Reyvateil’s mind, and watch over them as they grow up.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Reyvateils possuem um Guardião da Mente no Espaço da Alma. Ele protege sua mente e acompanha seu amadurecimento.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ライナーは彼女達に導かれ、精神世界を旅して行くことになります。
dialogues.original_en: Lyner will be guided by these guardians and travel through the soulspace.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Os guardiões guiam Lyner pelo Espaço da Alma.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 精神世界はレーヴァテイルの心の奥に眠っている願望や恐怖があらわれた世界です。現実とはまるで違う、「あるはずのない」世界が広がっています。
dialogues.original_en: The soulspace is a world that reflects the Reyvateils’ inner most desires and fears. It is a world that should not exist, and is different from the real world.
dialogues.current_ptbr: O Espaço da Alma reflete os desejos e medos mais íntimos da Reyvateil. É um mundo impossível, diferente da realidade.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 精神世界のイベントは、DPでその成否が決まります。CRDPはレーヴァテイルとの信頼度です。DPが足りていた場合、彼女達は心を許し、新たな一面を見せてくれます。
dialogues.original_en: Events in the soulspace may or may not occur depending on your DP. DP reflects the trust between you and the Reyvateil. If you have enough DP, she will show you a new side of her.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Eventos dependem do DP, que representa a confiança entre vocês. Com DP suficiente, ela mostrará um novo lado de si.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ですがDPが足りないと、CRレーヴァテイルの精神世界から追い出されてしまいます。精神世界へダイブする時は、DPを多めに持っておいた方がいいでしょう。
dialogues.original_en: But if you do not have enough DP, you will be kicked out of the Reyvateil’s soulspace. It is better to have a lot of DP when Diving in to the soulspace.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Sem DP suficiente, você é expulso do Espaço da Alma. Acumule bastante antes de mergulhar.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 精神世界でのイベントクリア時、レーヴァテイルが新たな詩を紡ぎ出すことがあります。戦闘やフィールドで使用する詩は、すべて精神世界から手に入ります。
dialogues.original_en: When you clear an event in the soulspace, the Reyvateil may craft a new song. Songs that will be used for battle and in the field will all be obtained through this soulspace.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Completar eventos pode criar novas Canções. As usadas em batalha e no cenário são obtidas no Espaço da Alma.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 強力な詩は、レーヴァテイルがそれだけあなたを信頼している証です。がんばってダイブしてください。
dialogues.original_en: A stronger song is proof that the Reyvateil trusts you. Good luck when Diving.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Canções mais fortes provam a confiança da Reyvateil. Boa sorte no Mergulho!

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ストーリー上、ダイブが必要となる場面も出てきます。その場合、ダイブイベントをこなすまでゲームは先へ進みません。ダイブはゲームを握る鍵となるでしょう。
dialogues.original_en: There are instances when you are required to Dive in the storyline. In that case, you must complete the event in order to continue with the story. Diving can be key to progress in the game.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Às vezes a história exige um Mergulho. Complete o evento para prosseguir: mergulhar pode ser essencial para avançar.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ダイブポイント
dialogues.original_en: Dive Point
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ponto de Mergulho

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: DP=ダイブポイントは、CRレーヴァテイルの精神世界でのイベントで、必要となるポイントです。ダイブポイントは戦闘終了時、経験値、お金と一緒に手に入ります。
dialogues.original_en: Dive Points (DP) are points required for events in the soulspace of Reyvateils. DP can be obtained along with experience points and money after a battle.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Pontos de Mergulho (DP) são gastos nos eventos do Espaço da Alma. Você os recebe após batalhas, junto de experiência e dinheiro.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 獲得されるDPは、パーティメンバーの数、その戦闘で与えた一番大きなダメージ、その戦闘で発動した詩魔法で、一番大きなバーストゲージの合計から算出されます。
dialogues.original_en: Obtainable DP is calculated by the number of party members, the highest damage during the fight, and the highest burst gauge of the activated Song Magic during the fight.
dialogues.current_ptbr: O DP ganho depende do número de aliados, do maior dano causado e do maior Burst de uma Canção ativada na luta.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: しかし、赤魔法の場合は発動前に戦闘が終わると、その時ためていたバーストゲージは計算されません。気をつけてください。
dialogues.original_en: But for red magic, if the battle ends before activation, the burst gauge for that magic will not be included.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Se a luta acabar antes de ativar a magia vermelha, seu Burst não conta para o DP.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: DPは、パーティにいるレーヴァテイルそれぞれが獲得し、精神世界にダイブする時にそれぞれのDPを消費することになります。
dialogues.original_en: Each Reyvateil in the party will obtain DP, and the DP for that Reyvateil will be used when diving into their soulspace.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cada Reyvateil recebe DP próprio, usado para mergulhar em seu Espaço da Alma.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 緑魔法
dialogues.original_en: Green Magic
dialogues.current_ptbr: Magia Verde

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 緑魔法はフィールド上でのみ使える魔法です。IM02ボタンを押すと、緑魔法が発射できます。
dialogues.original_en: Green magic can only be used on the field. By pressing the IM02 button, you will be able to shoot green magic.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Magia verde só funciona no cenário. Pressione IM02 para dispará-la.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 壁や閉じたドアの中に、緑魔法で破壊できるものがあります。緑魔法を何度もぶつけて耐久力を下げ、壁やドアを破壊してください。新たな道が開きます。
dialogues.original_en: There are some walls and closed doors that can be opened by green magic. Lower the durability by attacking multiple times to destroy them. New paths will open up to you.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Algumas paredes e portas podem ser destruídas com magia verde. Ataque várias vezes para reduzir a resistência e abrir caminhos.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 新しい緑魔法を覚えた時はIM22とIM23で緑魔法の切り替えが出来ます。特定の属性のみ破壊できるドアも存在するので、気になる場所には色々な緑魔法を試してみましょう。
dialogues.original_en: When you learn a new green magic, you can switch between them with IM22 and IM23. Some doors can only be opened by a specific kind, so try the different types where there may be something.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Troque as magias verdes com IM22 e IM23. Algumas portas exigem um tipo específico. Experimente onde houver algo suspeito.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: またドア以外にも壊せるものや緑魔法で変化が起きるものがあります。気になるものには緑魔法をぶつけてみましょう。
dialogues.original_en: There are things other than doors that can be destroyed or changed with green magic. If you notice anything, try using green magic on it.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Magia verde também destrói ou altera objetos além das portas. Ao notar algo estranho, tente usá-la.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: コスチューム
dialogues.original_en: Costume
dialogues.current_ptbr: Traje

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: コスチュームの変更はメインメニューの「装備」から行います。レーヴァテイルの装備画面に入ってみてください。CRコスチュームの欄があるはずです。
dialogues.original_en: You can change costumes in  ”Equipment” from the main menu. Enter the equipment screen for a Reyvateil. There is a column for costumes.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Troque trajes em 'Equipamento', no menu principal. Entre na tela da Reyvateil e procure a coluna de trajes.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: コスチュームごとにレーヴァテイルの様々なステータスが変化します。見た目で選ぶも性能で選ぶも、あなた次第!
dialogues.original_en: The Reyvateils’ stats varies and changes with each costume. It’s up to you whether you want to pick for looks or pick for stats!
dialogues.current_ptbr: Os atributos da Reyvateil mudam com o traje. Escolha pelo visual ou pelos efeitos: a decisão é sua!

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 新しいコスチュームは精神世界でイベントをクリアすることによって、手に入ります。いろいろなコスチュームを楽しみたい人は、精神世界をくまなく旅してみてください。
dialogues.original_en: New costumes will become available as you clear events in the soulspace. If you want to discover all the costumes, travel every corner of the soulspaces.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Trajes novos surgem ao completar eventos no Espaço da Alma. Explore todos os cantos para encontrar todos.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: もちろんコスチュームは戦闘でも着たままです。CRコスチュームの着せ替えが、戦闘を有利に、そして楽しくします!
dialogues.original_en: Of course, costumes will be worn in battle. The changing of costumes can make the battle better, and more enjoyable!
dialogues.current_ptbr: Os trajes aparecem em batalha. Trocá-los pode melhorar a luta e torná-la mais divertida!

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ・各用語の説明CR#1Burst Variation...詩魔法のレベル毎のバーストゲージの溜まる速度を表します。ラインが高い位置にあるほど速度も上がります。CR#1GD-REGIST...詩魔法を謳っている間に消費するMPの緩和量を表します。最大100%で消費MPは半分になります。CR#1HARMONICS...ハーモニクスCRゲージの増加量を表します。振りが速いほど増加量も多くなります。
dialogues.original_en: Explanation of TermsCRBurst Variation: This displays how fast the burst gauge fills up for the Song Magic on that level. The higher the line, the faster it fills.CRGD-REGIST: This displays how relaxed the singer is, affecting the MP usage of the Song. At 100%, half MP is consumed.
dialogues.current_ptbr: TermosCRVariação de Burst: indica a velocidade de carga da Canção nesse nível. Linha mais alta, carga mais rápida.CRGD-REGIST: indica o relaxamento da cantora e afeta o consumo de MP. A 100%, gasta metade do MP.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ため攻撃
dialogues.original_en: Stored Attack
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ataque armazenado

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 通常、敵はパーティキャラのみを攻撃してきます。前衛のキャラ全員が気絶していない限り、レーヴァテイルが攻撃されることはありません。
dialogues.original_en: Normally, the enemy will only attack characters in your party. Unless all characters in the front line are unconscious, the Reyvateil will not be attacked.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Normalmente os inimigos atacam a linha de frente. Só atacam a Reyvateil se todos nela desmaiarem.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ですが、レーヴァテイルのみを狙う特殊な攻撃も存在します。それがため攻撃です。ため攻撃が発動するとレーヴァテイルの周りにロックオンCRゲージが浮かび上がります。
dialogues.original_en: But there are certain attacks that targets only the Reyvateil. This is a stored attack. When a stored attack is activated, a lock-on guage will appear around the Reyvateil.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Certos ataques carregados visam só a Reyvateil. Um indicador de mira aparece ao redor dela quando são preparados.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ため攻撃を受けるとレーヴァテイルのバーストゲージは、受けたダメージに比例して減少します。さらにダメージを受け気絶した場合、ゲージは0%に戻ってしまいます。
dialogues.original_en: When a Reyvateil is attacked by a stored attack, her burst gauge will decrease in proportion to the damage she takes. If she becomes unconscious, the gauge will return to 0%.
dialogues.current_ptbr: O ataque carregado reduz Burst conforme o dano sofrido. Se a Reyvateil desmaiar, o medidor volta a 0%.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 防ぐためには「護る」です。敵のため攻撃が発動している間、ライナー達のコマンドに「護る」が追加されます。
dialogues.original_en: You must ”Guard” in order to prevent this. While the enemy is storing the attack, the ”Guard” command will be added.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Use 'Proteger' para impedir isso. O comando aparece enquanto o inimigo carrega o ataque.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 「護る」を選択することで、敵のため攻撃からレーヴァテイルをかばうことができます。ため攻撃のダメージはそのまま「護る」を使用したキャラが受けるので、注意を!
dialogues.original_en: By selecting ”Guard,” you may protect the Reyvateil from the enemy’s stored attack. The damage of the stored attack will be taken by the character who is guarding.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ao escolher 'Proteger', o personagem recebe o ataque carregado no lugar da Reyvateil.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 「護る」は不利ばかりではありません。「護る」が成功した直後は、敵へのカウンター攻撃が出来ます。カウンターはキャラの行動ターンに関係なく攻撃できます。
dialogues.original_en: ”Guard” is not all bad. In the case that it is successful, you will be able to counterattack the enemy. The character will counterattack even if it is not his turn to act.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Proteger também tem vantagem: se der certo, o personagem contra-ataca mesmo fora de seu turno.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ため攻撃の中にはレベル2、レベル3のため攻撃があります。ため攻撃を防ぐにはレベルと同じ人数の「護る」が必要です。
dialogues.original_en: There are level 2 and level 3 stored attacks. In order to prevent these stored attacks, you will need the same number of characters to ”Guard” as the level.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Há ataques carregados de níveis 2 e 3. Eles exigem, respectivamente, dois ou três personagens protegendo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 「護る」の効果は1ターンごとに切れるので、ため攻撃の発動に合わせて「護る」を使用してください。
dialogues.original_en: The effect of ”Guard” will disappear after one turn, so use the command at the same timing as the activation of the stored attack.
dialogues.current_ptbr: 'Proteger' dura um turno. Use no momento certo, próximo à ativação do ataque carregado.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 「護る」が成功するとハーモニクスゲージが一気に上昇します。レーヴァテイルとの絆で戦闘を勝利に導きましょう!
dialogues.original_en: When ”Guard” is successful, the Harmonics gauge will immediately increase. Bring victory to battle with your Reyvateil!
dialogues.current_ptbr: Proteger com sucesso aumenta Harmonics imediatamente. Vença junto de sua Reyvateil!

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 宿会話システム
dialogues.original_en: Inn Conversation System
dialogues.current_ptbr: Sistema conversa pousada

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 宿やキャンプで「やすむ」を選んだとき、ヒロイン達が部屋を訪れたり、会話ネタがある場合は自分からヒロインの部屋へ行ったりできます。
dialogues.original_en: When selecting ”Rest” at the Inn or Camp, Reyvateils may come to visit your room, or if you have something to say, you can visit their room to start a conversation.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ao descansar na pousada ou no acampamento, Reyvateils podem visitar seu quarto. Você também pode ir ao delas conversar.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: この宿会話は、ヒロインにダイブする際にとても重要な要素となります。会話終了時に出てくる「トークマター」がその鍵を握っています。
dialogues.original_en: This Inn Conversation is a very important element when you need to dive. The ”Talk Topic” which appears at the end of a conversation holds the key.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Conversas na pousada são essenciais aos Mergulhos. O 'Assunto' obtido ao fim da conversa é a chave.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 会話をすると、その会話レベルに応じたマスに、●が現れます。それが赤いマス分貯まると、そのレベルのコスモスフィアにアクセスできるようになります。
dialogues.original_en: When you start a conversation, a ● will appear in the box for that level of conversation. If you gather enough for the red box, you will be able to access the Cosmosphere for that level.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Uma conversa marca ● no espaço do nível correspondente. Preencha o quadro vermelho para acessar esse nível da Cosmosfera.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: トークマターを貯めないでダイブばかりしていると、どこかのレベルで頭打ちになってしまいますので要注意!
dialogues.original_en: If you continue to dive without saving Talk Topics, you could get stuck in a level somewhere, so be careful!
dialogues.current_ptbr: Mergulhar sem reunir assuntos pode bloquear seu avanço em algum nível. Cuidado!

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 宿会話のネタは、メインシナリオを進めたり、アイテムを合成すると生まれます。CRフィールドのいろいろな場所に落ちていることも!?
dialogues.original_en: Topics for Inn Conversations can be found in the main story or from synthesizing items. Sometimes you can find them in random places on the field!
dialogues.current_ptbr: Assuntos vêm da história, da síntese de itens e até de locais no cenário.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 現実世界での『宿会話』と、コスモスフィアへの『ダイブ』をバランス良くこなしていきましょう。
dialogues.original_en: Make sure to balance the Inn Conversations in the real world with dives in the Cosmosphere.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Equilibre as conversas no mundo real com os Mergulhos na Cosmosfera.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 伝説の聖女
dialogues.original_en: Legendary Maiden
dialogues.current_ptbr: Donzela lendária

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 第二紀の終焉、塔からあふれ出てくるウイルスによって人類が滅亡の危機にさらされた時に現れ、そして人々を救ったとされるレーヴァテイル。
dialogues.original_en: Reyvateils who appeared at the end of the second era, and saved mankind when they had come close to extinction from the overflow of virus from the tower.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Reyvateils que surgiram no fim da Segunda Era e salvaram a humanidade da extinção quando os vírus transbordaram da Torre.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 伝説の聖女はヒュムネクリスタルというアイテムを用い、そのクリスタルの秘めたる力「詩の力」を得ることによって、ウイルスを封印したと言われている。
dialogues.original_en: It is said that the Legendary Maidens used an item called the Hymn Crystal, and by gaining the hidden ”power of Song,” they sealed the virus.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Dizem que as Donzelas Lendárias usaram Cristais Hino para obter o poder oculto das Canções e selar os vírus.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ウイルス
dialogues.original_en: Virus
dialogues.current_ptbr: Vírus

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 正式名称は「導力情報ウイルス体」。塔内で生成され、導力線というネット回線を伝い、塔内を自由に移動できる。
dialogues.original_en: The standard name is the ”Symphonic Information Virus.” They are created in the tower, and can travel through symphonic lines, a network that runs throughout the tower.
dialogues.current_ptbr: O nome técnico é Vírus de Informação Sinfônica. São criados na Torre e viajam pelas Linhas Sinfônicas, sua rede de comunicação.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: また、高度なウイルスになると、フリップフロップ変換という技術によって現実世界に具現化し、人々に物理的危害を加えるものも出現する。CRライナー達エレミアの騎士が出動するのは、主にこの具現化したウイルスが発生したとき。
dialogues.original_en: The more advanced viruses can use Flip-Flop Conversion technology and can manifest the real world, and physically harm humans. Lyner and the Knights of Elemia are called out when these viruses become reality.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Vírus avançados usam conversão flip-flop para se materializar e ferir humanos. Lyner e os Cavaleiros de Elemia combatem os que tomam forma real.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ウイルスは「使徒の祭壇」と呼ばれる場所から湧き出てくる事が多い。CRウイルスは人を襲うようにプログラムされているため、具現化する場合もしない場合も、人に危害を与えるのが常。
dialogues.original_en: Most of the time, viruses come out of a place called the ”Altar of Apostles.” Since viruses are programmed to harm humans, whether they manifest the real world or not, they are usually hazardous to people.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Geralmente surgem no Altar dos Apóstolos. Programados para ferir humanos, são perigosos mesmo sem forma física.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 具現化しない場合は、塔のガーディアンを浸食し、それを支配し、人々に襲いかかる。
dialogues.original_en: In the case that they do not become tangible, they invade the guardian of the tower and take control of them to attack people.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Sem se materializar, podem invadir os guardiões da Torre e controlá-los para atacar pessoas.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイル
dialogues.original_en: Reyvateil
dialogues.current_ptbr: Reyvateil

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 「詩の力」を使うことが出来る、謳うだけで大地を揺らし、火を飛ばし、人を癒すことが出来る種族。詩を謳ったときに火の玉が出たり、その詩によって人々を回復できるのは、レーヴァテイルのみである。
dialogues.original_en: A kind of people who can use the ”power of songs” to shake the lands, throw fire, and heal people just by singing. Throwing fire balls and healing people, depending on the song, only happens when Reyvateil sing the Song.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Pessoas que usam o poder das Canções para abalar a terra, lançar fogo e curar. Os efeitos dependem da Canção entoada pela Reyvateil.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: そんな超常的な力を持つレーヴァテイルだが、唯一の弱点として、短命であることが挙げられる。通常、何もしない場合、長くて20年程度しか生きられない。
dialogues.original_en: Although these Reyvateil have such supernatural powers, their only weakness is that they have a short lifespan. Normally, if they do not do anything, they can only life for up to about 20 years.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Apesar dos poderes, têm vida curta. Sem tratamento, normalmente vivem apenas cerca de vinte anos.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 人間と同じくらい長生きするためには「延命剤」というものを定期的に投与する必要がある。現在その延命剤を作る技術があるのは「天覇」という企業と、「エル・エレミア教会」のみである。
dialogues.original_en: In order to live as long as humans, they must be administered doses of ”Life-Extention Agents.” Currently, the ”Tenba” and ”El Elemia Church” are the only ones with the technology to make this medicine.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Para viver tanto quanto humanos, precisam de agentes de prolongamento de vida. Só Tenba e Igreja de Elemia dominam sua produção atualmente.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: この2つの組織のいずれかに属していれば、無償で延命剤がもらえるため、レーヴァテイルはどちらかに属することが多い。また、それ故に弱みを握られ、人々にいいように扱われることもしばしばある。
dialogues.original_en: As long as they belong to either of these two organizations, they can receive the Life-Extension Agent for free, so most Reyvateil belong to one or the other. But because of this, they have a weakness, and are often taken advantage of.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Vinculadas a uma dessas organizações, recebem o agente de graça. Por dependerem dele, muitas Reyvateils são exploradas.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: また、レーヴァテイルには、インストールポイントという部分が存在し、そこからグラスノ結晶を取り込むこと(インストール)が可能だ。それによって、詩魔法の効果が急激に増大する。
dialogues.original_en: As long as they belong to Also, Reyvateil have an Install Point, from which they can install a glassnode crystal. By doing this, the effect of Song Magics are greatly increased.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Reyvateils também têm um Ponto de Instalação que recebe Cristais Grathnode. Isso fortalece muito as Magias de Canção.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: しかし、結構な苦痛を強いることになるため、本来は本当に信頼できる相手でなければインストールは行わないのが常識である。現在では、レーヴァテイルと人間との間でパワーバランスが崩れているため、レーヴァテイルがなし崩し的に人間に利用されている。
dialogues.original_en: But because this is a painful process, it is commonly known that they only allow those who are truly trusted to do the installation. Currently, because the power between Reyvateil and humans are so inbalanced, the Reyvateil are always used by humans.
dialogues.current_ptbr: A instalação dói, então só deixam alguém de confiança realizá-la. O desequilíbrio de poder ainda permite que humanos explorem Reyvateils.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルと共に戦う詩魔法戦で、レーヴァテイルの詩の力を強くするための理論。簡単に言ってしまえば、パートナーが頑張っている姿を見ることで、レーヴァテイル自
dialogues.original_en: In Song Magic battles with Reyvateil, this thoery is important to strengthen the song. A simple way of explaining this would be: the Reyvateil gain more motivation and morale from watching their partner fight.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Para fortalecer Canções, importa a motivação da Reyvateil ao ver seu parceiro lutar. Essa é a ideia básica da teoria.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 身のやる気、士気が上がるという単純なもの。アンビエンスとは「周囲、環境」という意味で、要するに「その場全体が盛り上がり、前衛もレーヴァテイルも戦闘力がアップする」という意味がある。
dialogues.original_en: Ambience describes the surrounding environment. In other words, everyone’s spirit rises in the area, and both the front line and the Reyvateil get a boost in power.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ambiência descreve o ambiente ao redor. O ânimo de todos cresce, fortalecendo a linha de frente e a Reyvateil.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ヒュムネクリスタル
dialogues.original_en: Hymn Crystal
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cristal Hymmnos

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルが塔をコントロールする為に謳う詩「ヒュムノス」が記憶されているクリスタル。現実的な表現をするのであれば、メモリーカードと言えば解りやすいだろう。
dialogues.original_en: Crystals that have lyrics called ”hymns” that are sung by Reyvateil to control the Tower. It’s like a memory card. The thoughts of the song are encrypted in these crystals which only Reyvateil can understand.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cristais que guardam Hinos para controlar a Torre. Como cartões de memória, contêm sentimentos codificados que só Reyvateils compreendem.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: この中に詩の「想い」が記憶されており、レーヴァテイルだけがその「想い」を正確にくみ取ることが出来る。ヒュムネクリスタルは、使用するレーヴァテイルによって全く違う詩を紡ぎ出すが、これはレーヴァテイル個々によって感性が違うことの表れである。しかし使用時の効果には変化はない。
dialogues.original_en: Hymn Crystals can craft a different song depending on the Reyvateil, but this is because each Reyvateil has a different sensibility. The effect when used are not different.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Um mesmo Cristal Hino gera Canções diferentes conforme a sensibilidade da Reyvateil. O efeito, porém, não muda.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ヒュムノス
dialogues.original_en: Hymns
dialogues.current_ptbr: Hinos

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ヒュムネクリスタルに記録されている、塔をコントロールするための詩。実際にヒュムノスが開発されていた第一紀には、数百種ものヒュムノスが存在していたといわれている。
dialogues.original_en: Songs that are recorded on Hymn Crystals, used to control the Tower. During the first era, when the hymns were actually invented, it is said that there were a couple hundred different hymns.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Canções registradas em Cristais Hino para controlar a Torre. Dizem que, na Primeira Era, havia algumas centenas de Hinos.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ヒュムノスと、通常の戦闘などで謳っている詩魔法との違いは、塔自体を制御する詩なのか、それともその塔から力をもらっている詩なのか、という違いである。
dialogues.original_en: The difference between hymns and Song Magic that is used in battle, is whether it is used to control the Tower itself, or is a song that takes power from the Tower.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Hinos controlam a própria Torre; Magias de Canção de batalha retiram poder dela.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ヒュムノスはいわば、塔の管理者権限としての力である。電気で例えるなら、詩魔法はご家庭にある炊飯釜やエアコンなどであり、ヒュムノスとは発電所の出力の上げ下げ、炉心棒のコントロールのようなものなのだ。
dialogues.original_en: Hymns are the Tower administer’s authoritative rights. Metaphorically speaking, Song Magic is like electricity in rice cookers and microwaves at home, while Hymns are the control switch for the output to a power plant.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Hinos são permissões de administração da Torre. Magia da Canção equivale à eletricidade dos aparelhos domésticos; Hinos, ao controle da usina.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エレミアの使徒
dialogues.original_en: Apostle of Elemia
dialogues.current_ptbr: Apóstolo de Elemia

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 第二紀終焉の時、伝説の聖女らと共にウイルス達と戦い、人々の滅亡を阻止した人達の事を、エレミアの使徒という。
dialogues.original_en: Those who fought the viruses with the legendary Holy Maiden to prevent the end of humanity at the end of the second era are called Apostles of Elemia.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Quem lutou com a Donzela Sagrada para impedir a extinção humana no fim da Segunda Era é chamado de Apóstolo de Elemia.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: その人々が、ウイルス頻出地点である「使徒の祭壇」を監視するために作った街がプラティナ。今プラティナに住む人々は、それらの人達の末裔であり、今でもウイルスからこの地を護るという使命を護り継いでいる。
dialogues.original_en: To watch over the Altar of Apostles, where viruses most frequently occur, these people created the city of Platina. The current residents of Platina are their descendants who still carry on their tasks to protect the land from viruses.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Criaram Platina para vigiar o Altar dos Apóstolos, foco de vírus. Seus descendentes ainda vivem lá e mantêm a missão de proteger a terra.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エレミアの騎士
dialogues.original_en: Knight of Elemia
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cavaleiro de Elemia

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エレミアの使徒の中でも、特に前線に出て戦う実働部隊。その数は少ないが、一人一人がウイルスと戦うための特殊な訓練を受け、例え一人でもウイルスを倒せるよう訓練さ
dialogues.original_en: The actual front line fighting division of the Apostles of Elemia. Although they are few in number, each fighter recieves special training in order to fight the virus. They are trained to be able to defeat a virus even on his own.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Tropa de combate dos Apóstolos de Elemia. São poucos, mas cada um recebe treino especial para derrotar um vírus sozinho.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: れている。シュレリアと共に行動することが多くなる。
dialogues.original_en: They are often found working with Shurelia.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Costumam trabalhar junto de Shurelia.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 使徒の祭壇
dialogues.original_en: Altar of Apostles
dialogues.current_ptbr: Altar dos Apóstolos

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: プラティナとほぼ同じ高度にある、ウイルスの多発ポイント。使徒の祭壇は、正式名称「導力プラグ」といい、塔がまだ健在だった頃は、塔の情報大動脈の末端部分、いわゆ
dialogues.original_en: A location on the same altitude as Platina, where Virus frequently appear. The standard name for the Altar of Apostles is the Symphonic Reactor. When the Tower was still active, this was the end connector for the main information artery.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Local à mesma altitude de Platina, com aparições frequentes de vírus. Seu nome técnico é Reator Sinfônico: era a conexão final da principal via de informação da Torre.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: るコネクタだった。その為、情報伝達量が大きく、また現実世界とバイナリ野との結合点である使徒の祭壇(導力プラグ)は、ウイルスが顕在するのに好条件が揃っているのである。
dialogues.original_en: Therefore, its capacity to relay information is very large. The Altar of Apostles (Symphonic Reactor) is also the point of union between the real world and the Binary Field which meets the conditions for viruses to become a tangible form.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Sua capacidade de transmitir dados é enorme. Também une o mundo real ao Campo Binário, permitindo a materialização dos vírus.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ELMA-DS
dialogues.original_en: ELMA-DS
dialogues.current_ptbr: ELMA-DS

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 物語の始まりに出てくるウイルスの名前。ELMA-DSの最大の特徴は、フリップフロップ変換を自由に行えることである。
dialogues.original_en: The name of the virus that appears at the beginning of this story. The most important characteristic about the ELMA-DS is that it can freely use flip-flop conversion.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Vírus do início da história. A principal característica de ELMA-DS é usar livremente conversão flip-flop.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: フリップフロップ変換とは、バイナリ野と実世界とで、身体の特性を変える技術のこと。要するに、物体をデータ化したり、データを物体化したりすることが出来る。
dialogues.original_en: Flip-flop conversion is a technology which can change bodily features within the Binary Field and the real world. In other words, it can change objects into data, and data into objects.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Conversão flip-flop transforma matéria em dados e dados em matéria, entre o Campo Binário e o mundo real.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: その為ELMA-DSは、危なくなったら物理攻撃が効かないバイナリ野へ逃げ込み、攻撃するときは現実に物質化するという行動をとる。この特殊能力を阻止する効果があるのが「パージャ」と言われるヒュムノス。
dialogues.original_en: Therefore, ELMA-DS will escape into the Binary Field to avoid physical attacks, and come back in a tangible form when it decides to attack. The Hymn Crystal Purger can stop it from taking this kind of action.
dialogues.current_ptbr: ELMA-DS foge ao Campo Binário para evitar golpes e se materializa para atacar. O Cristal Hino Purger impede essa alternância.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ライナーはこれを見つけるために、ホルスの翼へ降り立った。
dialogues.original_en: Lyner descends onto the Wing of Horus in order to go find this crystal.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Lyner desce às Asas de Horus para buscar esse cristal.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ヒュムノスワード
dialogues.original_en: Hymnos
dialogues.current_ptbr: Hymmnos

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ヒュムノス語と言われている塔と意思疎通するための言語。「想音(そういん)」と言われる、現在の自分の感情や気分を現す言葉から始まり、動詞、目的語、装飾語と続く構
dialogues.original_en: Hymnos is the language that allows communication with the Tower. The sentence begins by stating the [Emotion Sound], which describes your current feelings, and is followed by the verb, subject, and adjective.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Hymmnos é a língua de comunicação com a Torre. A frase começa pelo [Som Emocional], que expressa sentimentos, seguido de verbo, sujeito e adjetivo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 文を持つ。詩が「想い」を伝える事を大切にしている事の現れなのである。ヒュムノスワードは独自の文字列を持つ。#0Abcdefg Hijkなどと表記されているものが、ヒュムノスワードである。CRヒュムノスを始めとして、詩魔法は全部、このヒュムノスワードで塔とコンタクトを取り、力を享受しているのである。
dialogues.original_en: This describes the importance that the Song has on emotions. Hymnos has a unique sound. Lines that look like #0Abcdefg are Hymnos.  All Song Magic, including Hymns, use this language to make contact with the Tower to power them.
dialogues.current_ptbr: As Canções dependem das emoções. Hymmnos tem som próprio; linhas como #0Abcdefg são nessa língua. Todas as Magias de Canção e Hinos a usam para obter poder da Torre.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: バイナリ野
dialogues.original_en: Binary Field
dialogues.current_ptbr: Campo binário

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 塔内に張り巡らされた導力ラインと呼ばれる情報伝達網、それを統べるSPUといわれる中央処理施設によって維持されている、情報世界のこと。
dialogues.original_en: The informational world maintained by a central processing facility called the SPU, and its vast network around the Tower called the Symphonic Power Lines.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Mundo de informação mantido pela unidade central SPU e pela rede de Linhas de Energia Sinfônica da Torre.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 要するに、実体がないデータの世界(01の世界)であり、簡単に言ってしまえば「プログラム」の世界である。現実に置き換えて言うなら、このゲームのキャラ達、またネットゲームのプレイヤーキャラなどは全員、バイナリ野の住人ということになる。
dialogues.original_en: In other words, a non-physical cyberspace of data (a world of 0’s and 1’s), and more simply put, a world of programs. As an example, the characters of this game, and player characters of internet games are all residents of the Binary Field.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Ciberespaço sem matéria, feito de zeros, uns e programas. Personagens deste jogo e avatares de jogos on-line são exemplos de habitantes do Campo Binário.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: HC『パージャ』
dialogues.original_en: HC ”Purger”
dialogues.current_ptbr: HC “Purger”

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 塔とリンクしているプログラムを切断するブレイクコマンド。これを使用すると、プログラムは、その行動を中断する。もしくは実体化している場合は、塔との交信ができな
dialogues.original_en: A break command to disconnect the link between the Tower and a program. When this is used, the program being used will be interrupted.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Comando que rompe a ligação de um programa com a Torre e interrompe sua execução.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: くなるため、情報体に戻ることが出来なくなる。
dialogues.original_en: If a virus is taking a physical form, it will no longer be able to communicate with the Tower, and therefore will be unable to return to a body of data.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Um vírus materializado perde a comunicação com a Torre e não consegue voltar à forma de dados.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: エル・エレミア教会
dialogues.original_en: Elemia Church
dialogues.current_ptbr: Igreja de Elemia

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 太古の昔に実在したと言われている「エレミア三謳神」をまつる教会。謳うだけで人々を癒し、この世界を豊かにしたと語り伝える「エル・エレミア伝承」を教義としている
dialogues.original_en: A church that enshrines the Trio of Elemia. An organization that uses the Elemia Legends as its doctrine. They preach that singing can heal people and make the world peaceful.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Igreja que cultua o Trio de Elemia e segue suas lendas. Ensina que cantar pode curar e trazer paz ao mundo.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 団体。エレミア三謳神復活の為のミッションをこなす一方地域の人達の安全を確保したりといった、公共福祉的な役割も行っている。
dialogues.original_en: They also provide public welfare, such as protecting the safety of those who are on the mission to revive the Trio of Elemia.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Também presta assistência pública e protege quem participa da missão de reviver o Trio de Elemia.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 聖女(聖女候補)
dialogues.original_en: Holy Maiden (Candidate)
dialogues.current_ptbr: Donzela sagrada (candidata)

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 教会でのレーヴァテイルの呼び名。厳密には、神を下ろすことが出来るヒュムネクリスタル「リンカ」を手に入れたレーヴァテイルを「聖女」と呼び、現状教会に所属する
dialogues.original_en: The Church uses this term for Reyvateil. In a strict sense, only Reyvateil who have obtained the Hymn Crystal Linker, which allows a god to decend into them, are called Holy Maidens.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Termo da Igreja para Reyvateils. Estritamente, só quem obtém Linker e pode receber uma divindade é Donzela Sagrada.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルは全員CR「聖女候補」でしかない。
dialogues.original_en: The Reyvateils who are currently registered to the church are only Holy Maiden candidates.
dialogues.current_ptbr: As Reyvateils atualmente vinculadas à Igreja são apenas candidatas a Donzela Sagrada.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 詩魔法
dialogues.original_en: Song Magic
dialogues.current_ptbr: Magia da Canção

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レーヴァテイルだけが使える魔法形態。別名「妄想魔法」と言われており、レーヴァテイルが現実化を強く念じた想像物が現実に現れるという魔法である。紡ぎ出すのはレー
dialogues.original_en: A form of magic that only Reyvateil can use, also known as ”Imaginary Magic.” When a Reyvateil wishes strong enough, the object of her imaginations will become a physical object in reality.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Magia exclusiva das Reyvateils, também chamada Magia Imaginária. Um desejo intenso pode tornar real o objeto imaginado.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: ヴァテイルだが、その具現化に必要な力は塔から享受する。レーヴァテイルは詩魔法を唱えているとき、塔と繋がっているのだ。
dialogues.original_en: Reyvateil are the ones who craft the magic, but the energy needed for the physical manifestation is received by the Tower. This means that Reyvateil are connected to the Tower when they sing a Song Magic.
dialogues.current_ptbr: A Reyvateil cria a magia, mas a Torre fornece energia para materializá-la. Por isso, elas se conectam à Torre ao cantar.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 天覇(てんぱ)
dialogues.original_en: Tenba
dialogues.current_ptbr: Tenba

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: この世界のありとあらゆるモノを開発し、そしてこの世界を技術的に潤す大企業。その分野は多岐にわたり、生活必需品から軍隊まで、様々。CR天覇は様々な分野でレーヴァテイルの力を使っている。
dialogues.original_en: A large corporation that has developed many things, and has technologically advanced this world. They have many branches of companies from basic necessities to armed forces. Tenba use the power of Reyvateil in many of these areas.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Grande empresa responsável por muitos avanços tecnológicos. Atua de produtos básicos às forças armadas e usa Reyvateils em várias áreas.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 特に軍隊の中には戦闘用のレーヴァテイルが多数在籍している。天覇は、人が入ることを許されていない塔の中枢に入り込み、その古代期の文明を持ちだして自分たちの技術にするという事を行っている。
dialogues.original_en: Especially in the armed forces, there are many Reyvateil registered as fighters.  Tenba enter the central system of the Tower where people are normally not allowed to go, and retrieve techonology from the ancient civilization to make it their own.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Muitas Reyvateils são combatentes da Tenba. A empresa invade o sistema central da Torre, normalmente proibido, para obter tecnologia antiga.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: それによって人々の生活は大いに潤い、豊かになった。しかし、外敵から人々を守る生活保障などの面で、多少高額な金額を請求したりと、評判の悪い一面があるのも事実。
dialogues.original_en: Because of this, many peoples’ lives have become better. But they do have a bad reputation for taking a lot of money in exchange for protecting peoples’ lifestyles from outside enemies.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Isso melhorou a vida de muita gente, mas a empresa cobra caro para proteger a população e tem má reputação.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 最近ではレーヴァテイルの扱いが極端に粗雑であるとのことで、一部から非難の声が出ている。
dialogues.original_en: Recently, they have been criticized for treating their Reyvateil extremely harsh.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Recentemente, recebeu críticas pelos maus-tratos às Reyvateils.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: この世界の標準的な技術体系の一つ。「グラスノ結晶」を用いて複数アイテムを合成することで、特別な力を持ったアイテムを作り出す技術。
dialogues.original_en: A standard form of technology in this world. A skill in which you can create items with special powers by using a [Grathnode Crystal] to synthesize multiple items.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Tecnologia comum que usa [Cristal Grathnode] para sintetizar vários ingredientes em itens com poderes especiais.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: グラスノ結晶
dialogues.original_en: Grathnode Crystal
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cristal Grathnode

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 大昔からそこかしこに落ちている、特殊な力を秘めた結晶。アイテムとかけ合わせれば特殊な効果が付いたアイテムを作ることが出来、レーヴァテイルにインストールすれば、そのレーヴァテイルの詩魔法が強くなるという優れもの。
dialogues.original_en: A crystal with special hidden powers that can be found all around the world since ancient times. By combining it with items, you can create an item with a special effect, and by installing in Reyvateils, you can make their Song Magic stronger.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cristal com poder oculto, encontrado desde a antiguidade. Combinado a itens, cria efeitos; instalado em Reyvateils, fortalece Canções.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 現在の文明がここまで発展したのは、グラスノ結晶のお陰と言っても過言ではない。その能力は、グラスノ結晶ごとに全く違う。
dialogues.original_en: It wouldn’t be wrong to say that current civilization was able to come this far thanks to these Grathnode Crystals. Each Grathnode Crystal has a different ability.
dialogues.current_ptbr: A civilização deve muito aos Cristais Grathnode. Cada cristal tem uma capacidade diferente.

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: レシピカード
dialogues.original_en: Recipe Cards
dialogues.current_ptbr: Cartas de receita

dialogues.speaker: Sistema / Narração
dialogues.original_jp: 世界中に散らばっている、誰が作ったのかもわからない、グラスメルクの合成方法が記されたカード。このカードをゲットすることで、新たな組み合わせで新たなアイテムを
dialogues.original_en: A card that tells you the crafting method for Grathmelding. No one knows who made them, but they are scattered throughout the world.
dialogues.current_ptbr: Carta que ensina uma receita de Grathmelding. Sua origem é desconhecida; estão espalhadas pelo mundo.
